_comment: One finding, and it is a statistic about the whole vault rather than about a file: every one of the eight links uses the verb 'supports'. The vault is otherwise well formed, which is the point — a collapsed verb taxonomy is not detectable in any single note. The fixture lowers verb_monoculture_min_links from 20 to 6 so a four-note vault can carry the measurement; exit stays 0 at the default threshold because the finding is advisory.
